profile: new controlled I/O profile; historical four-phase I/O values were not separately recorded

io_controlled_profile.history_boundary: Earlier c68 four-phase environment was fixed across phases but these I/O values were not individually recorded; they cannot be retroactively assumed default.

limitations: Package debug=1/strip=none differs from formal timing artifacts.

Some optimized call chains end in unresolved frames; leaf symbols and positive inline-source evidence are more reliable than full caller attribution.
Perf header-only diagnostics emit HEADER_EVENT_DESC metadata warning; normal reports/scripts parse all samples with matching counts.
Hardware cycles unavailable; this is software CPU sampling.
